run_evaluation: run the VideoCLIP retrieval evaluation using a YAML config file and model checkpoint
run_get_yaml_config: run get_yaml_config to load and instantiate a YAML configuration from CLI arguments
test_VideoCLIPLightningModule: test a VideoCLIPLightningModule checkpoint against the MUGEN test dataloader using PyTorch Lightning
review_evaluate: review the evaluate function that sets up MUGENDataModule, loads a VideoCLIP checkpoint, and runs trainer.test
refactor_get_yaml_config: refactor get_yaml_config to support additional config sources beyond OmegaConf CLI arguments
